resolved_during_review.scenario: Changing dates or meal selection while an asynchronous copy commit is in flight can make the form describe a different batch than the one being saved.
resolved_during_review.resolution: Disable form inputs and cancel while JournalStore.busy; preserve the prepared UUID batch on errors.

resolved_during_review.scenario: Navigation from Today can inherit a hidden navigation bar, leaving the new review page without a discoverable return control.
resolved_during_review.resolution: Explicitly show the navigation bar on JournalReviewView.

resolved_during_review.scenario: At accessibility text sizes, week navigation labels wrap into multiple lines and a nested horizontal date strip intercepts vertical page gestures.
resolved_during_review.resolution: Use icon-only previous/next labels at accessibility sizes and an adaptive date grid with 44pt minimum targets.

resolved_during_review.scenario: A chart category based on UUID exposes internal record identifiers in accessibility.
resolved_during_review.resolution: Use chronological numeric positions and explicit date, workout name and volume accessibility labels.

resolved_during_review.scenario: A completed cardio working set may have no distance. Summing nil as zero displayed a false 0m total and difference.
resolved_during_review.resolution: Distance totals are optional and carry a missing count; UI says unrecorded/partial and withholds comparison unless both sessions are complete. Verified in foundation and native batch 7.

traced_scenarios: Rapid confirm taps are guarded by the journal busy flag and stable-ID repository replay equality.
Commit failure rolls back copied records and component Health intents together; retry uses the same batch.
A partial committed replay or changed entry with reused IDs is rejected atomically.
Changing or archiving source food does not rewrite copied nutrient snapshots.
Stored localDate is preserved during review; source wall clock is mapped to target timezone with tested DST policy.
Archived or changed-type exercises do not mix measurement kinds; deleted or abandoned sessions do not create progress.
Unknown calories or absent dates are excluded from the mean denominator rather than imputed as zero.
testing_gaps: Physical-device HealthKit, minimum-iOS-18 and real VoiceOver acceptance are not newly claimed.
residual_risks: Repeated intentionally confirmed copies after reopening are separate batches; existing-target count and additive-copy warning remain visible.
